mechanism: Fish oil has antiplatelet and anticoagulant effects that may oppose the procoagulant activity of vitamin K, potentially reducing vitamin K's effectiveness in correcting coagulopathy or maintaining anticoagulation stability.
action: Monitor INR/PT closely in patients on warfarin or other vitamin K-dependent anticoagulants who take concurrent fish oil; adjust anticoagulant dosing as needed based on coagulation parameters.
